classification.difficultyReason: Locate named sectors in a quadrilateral with a diagonal and an extended side.

content.prompt: Draw an arc to show these angles on the diagram.

spec.description: Unfilled quadrilateral PQRS, diagonal PR, and horizontal extension RT. Q, R and T are labelled above; P and S below. No answer arc.
spec.mathematics: Q,R,T are collinear in that order. No parallelism, equal lengths or measurements are asserted.
spec.answerVisibility: Black given geometry only; blue source answer arc is stored separately.

answer.worked: The middle letter gives vertex $Q$. Draw the interior arc between $QP$ and $QR$.

spec.description: Blue interior arc at Q from QP to QR.
spec.mathematics: The non-reflex sector below QR and to the right of QP is angle PQR.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer-only overlay, composed with the corresponding question diagram.

spec.description: Unfilled quadrilateral PQRS with diagonal PR and top edge QR extended to T. No arc is supplied to students.
spec.mathematics: Q,R,T are collinear in that order. R lies on arm QT. No parallel or equal-length markings.
spec.answerVisibility: Given geometry only; completed source arc is answer-only.

answer.worked: The middle letter gives vertex $Q$. Draw the interior arc between $QP$ and $QT$. Since $R$ lies on $QT$, this is the same sector as in part a.

spec.description: Blue interior arc at Q joining QP to QT, ending on the QR portion of QT.
spec.mathematics: Angles PQT and PQR share the same boundary rays.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer-only overlay on the corresponding base figure.

spec.description: Unfilled PQRS with diagonal PR and horizontal extension RT. Labels Q,R,T above and P,S below.
spec.mathematics: PR lies inside angle QPS. Q,R,T are collinear; no parallel or equal-length markings.
spec.answerVisibility: Given geometry only; completed blue arc is answer-only.

answer.worked: The middle letter gives vertex $P$. Draw the complete interior arc between $PQ$ and $PS$, crossing the internal diagonal $PR$.

spec.description: One blue arc spans the complete interior angle at P, from PS through PR to PQ.
spec.mathematics: The boundary arms are PQ and PS, not PR.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer-only overlay on the corresponding base figure.

spec.description: Unfilled PQRS, diagonal PR and top-edge extension RT. No student-visible answer arc.
spec.mathematics: The requested sector lies between diagonal RP and side RS at R. No parallel or equal-length relationships are given.
spec.answerVisibility: Given geometry only; completed source arc is answer-only.

answer.worked: The middle letter gives vertex $R$. Draw the small interior arc between diagonal $RP$ and side $RS$.

spec.description: Blue arc below and left of R, between RP and RS.
spec.mathematics: Marks only angle PRS, bounded by the diagonal and the right side.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer-only overlay on the corresponding base figure.

spec.description: Unfilled PQRS with diagonal PR and horizontal extension RT, retaining exterior clearance below RT.
spec.mathematics: Q,R,T are collinear in that order. The requested non-reflex angle is exterior to the quadrilateral.
spec.answerVisibility: Given geometry only; completed blue arc is answer-only.

answer.short: Exterior arc at $R$ joining $RT$ and $RS$ below $RT$.
answer.worked: The middle letter gives vertex $R$. Draw the non-reflex exterior arc from $RT$ clockwise to $RS$, below $RT$.

spec.description: Blue non-reflex exterior arc at R, below RT, connecting RT and RS.
spec.mathematics: The sector runs clockwise from RT to RS; the equivalent counterclockwise construction runs from RS to RT.

spec.description: Unfilled PQRS with diagonal PR and horizontal extension RT. Point labels remain outside the boundary.
